The change starts from the first token of the node and moves forward until it finds the `=>` punctuator. Alternatively, keep the logic to find the token before the arrow token even when searching forward to the arrow token.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect token detection for arrow spacing check
rawFindings.explanation:
The original code used sourceCode.getTokenBefore(node.body) to find the arrow token before the arrow function's body, then stepped backward until it found a token with value '=>'.

The changed code instead starts from the first token of the node and moves forward token by token until it finds the '=>' punctuator. It also tracks the previous token as 'before'.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original approach using getTokenBefore(node.body) and stepping backward until reaching the '=>' token to reliably identify the arrow token and its neighboring tokens. Also, ensure to keep or add back the skipped test cases for nested arrow functions to verify correctness.
